corrections.description: A duplicate connection is not an edit. The donor pushes a no-op undo step and counts an edit, so the next undo appears to do nothing. The port records nothing, and the next undo reverts the real connection.

A storyboard group keeps its re-anchored outside edges across a save and reload. The donor's load normalization drops every edge touching a group node (groups have no handles), so a reloaded storyboard loses those connections and ungrouping cannot restore them. The port keeps and restores them.

Drafts are isolated per user (spec §7: keyed by user, project, candidate and server revision). The donor keys drafts by project and canvas only, so a second user of the same project and canvas in the same browser reads the first user's draft. The port returns none.

Save failures are classified by the M8-A exploration API. The donor recognizes only its own backend codes, so an unknown candidate (404), a rejected body (422), a transient server failure (503) and a network failure all become one generic error. The port distinguishes not_found, invalid and retryable outcomes; a 409 conflict is handled the same way by both.
